title: Eligibility Interviewers, Government Programs
description: Determine eligibility of persons applying to receive assistance from government programs and agency resources, such as welfare, unemployment benefits, social security, and public housing.

tasks.text: Interview and investigate applicants for public assistance to gather information pertinent to their applications.
Interview benefits recipients at specified intervals to certify their eligibility for continuing benefits.
Check with employers or other references to verify answers and obtain further information.
Investigate claimants for the possibility of fraud or abuse.
Conduct annual, interim, and special housing reviews and home visits to ensure conformance to regulations.

clusters.label: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Interpret and explain information such as eligibility requirements, application details, payment methods, and applicants' legal rights.
Answer applicants' questions about benefits and claim procedures.
Keep records of assigned cases, and prepare required reports.
Prepare applications and forms for applicants for such purposes as school enrollment, employment, and medical services.
Initiate procedures to grant, modify, deny, or terminate assistance, or refer applicants to other agencies for assistance.
Provide applicants with assistance in completing application forms, such as those for job referrals or unemployment compensation claims.

clusters.label: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Compute and authorize amounts of assistance for programs, such as grants, monetary payments, and food stamps.
Compile, record, and evaluate personal and financial data to verify completeness and accuracy, and to determine eligibility status.

clusters.label: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Provide social workers with pertinent information gathered during applicant interviews.
Refer applicants to job openings or to interviews with other staff, in accordance with administrative guidelines or office procedures.
Schedule benefits claimants for adjudication interviews to address questions of eligibility.
Monitor the payments of benefits throughout the duration of a claim.

skills.name: Speaking
skills.def: Talking to others to convey information effectively.

skills.name: Active Listening
skills.def: Giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times.

skills.name: Reading Comprehension
skills.def: Understanding written sentences and paragraphs in work-related documents.

skills.name: Writing
skills.def: Communicating effectively in writing as appropriate for the needs of the audience.

skills.name: Social Perceptiveness
skills.def: Being aware of others' reactions and understanding why they react as they do.

skills.name: Service Orientation
skills.def: Actively looking for ways to help people.

skills.name: Critical Thinking
skills.def: Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.

skills.name: Judgment and Decision Making
skills.def: Considering the relative costs and benefits of potential actions to choose the most appropriate one.

skills.name: Active Learning
skills.def: Understanding the implications of new information for both current and future problem-solving and decision-making.

skills.name: Monitoring
skills.def: Monitoring/Assessing performance of yourself, other individuals, or organizations to make improvements or take corrective action.

skills.name: Coordination

skills.name: Complex Problem Solving
skills.def: Identifying complex problems and reviewing related information to develop and evaluate options and implement solutions.

skills.name: Negotiation

skills.name: Time Management

skills.name: Persuasion

skills.name: Electronic mail software
skills.def: Software to compose, send, or receive email. Examples: Email software, Microsoft Outlook.

skills.name: Spreadsheet software
skills.def: Software to create or edit numbers or text organized into rows and columns of cells. May include formulas which recalculate values based on other cells. Examples: Microsoft Excel.

skills.name: Office suite software

skills.name: Word processing software

skills.name: Video conferencing software

skills.name: Data base user interface and query software
